title: Skull foramina and canals: original source annotations
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Locate nine original author annotations in their source bone models. Compare whole-bone context with a focused native-coordinate view and describe the visible model relationships.

scenes.title: Foramen magnum — bone context
scenes.prompt: Identify the marker within the entire source bone, then compare the focused view.
scenes.note: Foramen magnum. The marker uses the original author label endpoint in native XYZ millimeters. The surrounding surface retains the original source geometry. This point identifies an authored location; the model surface provides its displayed context. Laterality follows the source object names. Rotate the view and adjust opacity to explore the relationship.

source_annotation.reference: Z-Anatomy 9de5d6912a1b0df9cab739d57f00e036b0496ddc, Z-Anatomy/__init__.py, OBJECT_OT_make_label: the original label line stores the indicated location at vertex 1 and hooks that vertex to its parent anatomical object. Full license and source attribution accompany the model.
